# Navflex Inc. - Code of Conduct

## Our Pledge

We, as members of Navflex Inc., are committed to fostering a respectful, safe, and inclusive working environment. Whether you're working on internal code, participating in meetings, or engaging in company communication channels, we pledge to treat each other with professionalism, empathy, and respect.

## Our Standards

Positive behavior examples include:

- Acting with empathy, courtesy, and professionalism
- Respecting different opinions, experiences, and roles
- Providing and receiving feedback constructively
- Collaborating with patience and open-mindedness
- Maintaining confidentiality and company trust

Unacceptable behavior includes:

- Offensive or discriminatory remarks (verbal, written, or visual)
- Harassment, bullying, intimidation, or threats
- Disrespecting boundaries or work-life balance
- Dismissing ideas or individuals in a demeaning way
- Sharing confidential or proprietary information without permission

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to all Navflex-related activities and communications, including (but not limited to) private repositories, project discussions, documentation reviews, team chats (e.g., Slack, Teams), emails, meetings, and any internal or external events where Navflex is represented.

## Enforcement

Violations of this Code of Conduct may be reported confidentially to the appropriate HR contact or manager at:

**📧 info@navflex.com**

All reports will be handled discreetly, investigated promptly, and addressed with fairness and respect to all parties. Retaliation against anyone reporting an issue in good faith will not be tolerated.

## Attribution

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1, available at
https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct/

Modifications have been made for private and internal use within Navflex Inc.
